name: Pine Floors in Century Homes: Refinishing Softwood in Seattle
title-tag: Refinishing Pine Floors in Seattle, WA Century Homes
meta-description: Pine and fir floors in Seattle century homes can be refinished — with softwood rules: gentler sanding, natural finish over stain, honest expectations on dents.
post-summary: December 25, 2026 · Seattle’s pre-1930 homes run on softwood — fir downstairs, pine up — and refinishing it is a different job than oak. How we sand it without chewing it up, why natural beats stain on softwood, the thickness check every century floor needs, and what these floors will and won’t give you.
